scope_detail: Recorded finished_at minus started_at in execute_job. Includes materialization, evaluation, diagnostics, imports inside this interval and tracking publication. Excludes process startup, module imports and code/dependency validation before started_at, plus artifact hashing and final job-result writing after finished_at. Not a CPU timer or a per-trial timer.
clock: timezone-aware recorded wall clock, not process CPU time
attempt_scope: Recorded successful execute_job body only; does not reconstruct earlier interrupted attempts, prove fresh training instead of reuse, or infer a per-trial duration.

granularity.replication_job: one subprocess job for all three seeds; no inferred per-trial duration
